name: Bisceglie (Italy)
description: White field with a red cross set towards the fly and lower edge, the upper hoist quarter charged with the crowned municipal arms of Bisceglie (a tree on red) within branches.
history: Municipal flag of Bisceglie, a comune in Apulia; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office.

features.role: off-centre cross with arms set towards the fly and bottom
Bisceglie arms — tree on red, crowned, within branches
